WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01'
),
filtered_catalog_returns AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM catalog_returns 
    JOIN date_range ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
)
SELECT w_state, i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cs_sold_date_sk < '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cs_sold_date_sk >= '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM catalog_returns 
LEFT OUTER JOIN filtered_catalog_returns ON cr_order_number = cr_order_number AND cr_item_sk = cr_item_sk
JOIN warehouse ON cr_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
JOIN item ON i_item_sk = cr_item_sk
WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
